content.text:
Finding submitted: **deviation** on § 2.1 (p0012).

- **Issue:** A three-year, USD 2m/year take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights" — the playbook's walk-away scenario, and short of the fallback (12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up not penalty).
- **Conflict:** §§ 7.1, 9.4 and 12.3 all assume no minimum-volume commitment, and there is no order-of-precedence clause, so § 2.1 risks overriding them.
- **Redline (validated, preferred level):** replace the commitment with pay-only-for-Services-used-or-ordered language, with the 12-month reducible/true-up commitment offered as a fallback in the comment.
